description: This file defines core service functions for scoring claims, generating claim relationships, and retrieving claims from a queue within an insurance fraud detection platform. It includes helper functions for evaluating rules and accessing claim fields.

classes.name: Claim
classes.description: Represents an insurance claim, with fields such as claimant_email, claimant_phone, policy_number, raw_payload, and status.

classes.name: ClaimScore
classes.description: Represents the scoring result for a claim, including total_score and matched_rules details.

classes.name: ClaimRelationship
classes.description: Represents relationships between claims, indicating potential linkages based on claimant email, phone, or policy number.

classes.name: ScoringRule
classes.description: Defines scoring rules with conditions, scores, and priorities used in claim evaluation.

methods.name: Any _get_field_value(claim: Claim, field: str)
methods.description: Retrieves a specified field's value from a claim, supporting nested payload access.

methods.name: Optional[Decimal] _coerce_number(v: Any)
methods.description: Converts a value to a Decimal if possible, else returns None.

methods.name: bool _evaluate_condition(claim: Claim, condition: Dict[str, Any])
methods.description: Evaluates a rule condition against a claim, supporting operators like exists, gt, gte, lt, lte, eq, neq, contains, in, regex.

methods.name: ClaimScore score_claim(claim: Claim)
methods.description: Scores a claim based on enabled scoring rules, creating a ClaimScore record, updating claim status.

methods.name: int generate_relationships_for_claim(claim: Claim)
methods.description: Creates relationships between a claim and other claims sharing email, phone, or policy number.

methods.name: get_queue_queryset(min_score: Optional[int] = None)
methods.description: Returns a queryset of claims ordered by latest update, optionally filtering by minimum score.

ctags.name: _link
ctags.pattern: /^    def _link(other_qs, rel_type: str, key: str) -> None:$/
